content: Upgrade to AtlasVoice Pro — 200+ AI voices, MP3 export and bulk generation, from $59/yr.

New — read-along highlighting & listen to selected text. The player now highlights each sentence (and each word, with supported voices) as it reads aloud, and visitors can select any passage to hear just that part — or click a word to start reading from there. Both are off by default: turn them on under AtlasVoice → Highlight, pick your colors, optionally dim the rest of the article to help readers focus, and enable auto-scroll.
